item.title: Giant overgrown hedge on public pathway, 12th August
item.description:
The hedge outside our home 56 steyning Grove used to be maintained and cut by the council in 2022 at least twice that year but not over the summer because of nesting. Since 2022 we have maintained the public pathway hedge because the council is not responding. It’s overgrown yet again causing a lot of people to walk on the grass on the side this is difficult for elderly people who come. It’s been 4 years nearly and we’ve had no one regularly maintaining and cutting back the hedge.

Report on FixMyStreet
